question: A chord AB of a circle is 30 cm long. If the perpendicular distance from the center to AB is 12 cm, calculate the radius of the circle. Also, determine the distance of another chord of length 24 cm from the center.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius r = √[(Chord/2)² + (Distance)²]

r = √[15² + 12²] = √[225 + 144] = √369 ≈ 19.2 cm.

For the second chord, Distance = √[r² − (New Chord/2)²]

Distance = √[369 − 12²] = √[369 − 144] = √225 = 15 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.2 cm, 15 cm.**
